budget_formula: hours = planned_tokens / (3600 * measured_tokens_per_second); add measured setup/startup/eval/save costs
timing_scope: Active run() wall time; excludes process import, gaps between invocations and terminal sidecar/log/summary writes after the saved watermark. Incomplete clocks are lower bounds, unsuitable for complete cost curves. Setup includes compile-wrapper construction; first update includes any lazy compilation.
